The system must automatically trigger the most appropriate remediation action—code rollback, scaling, ticket creation, on-call paging, or direct fix—while maintaining a complete, immutable audit trail, guaranteeing sub-second latency at planetary scale, and self-healing any component failure without human involvement.\
Also, don't forget to ultrathink about the things that should be send to me (or also to me).
